description: This file defines the ConnectionBuilderDelegates class, which manages a list of configuration actions (delegates) for IConnectionBuilder objects, allowing registration of configuration steps and invoking all registered configurations on a builder.

classes.name: ConnectionBuilderDelegates
classes.description: A class encapsulating a list of configuration delegates for IConnectionBuilder, providing methods to add and invoke these delegates.

methods.name: Add
methods.description: Adds a new configuration delegate to the list, throws ArgumentNullException if the delegate is null.

methods.name: Invoke
methods.description: Iterates over all registered configuration delegates and invokes them with the provided IConnectionBuilder instance.
